senses.gloss: f. (זקק) [the transparent one, cmp. זְבוּגָא,] chamæleon (v. Sm. Ant. s. v.).
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b:19">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite> ed. (Ms. M. <he>זקותא</he>, Ms. F. <he>רקיתא</he>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 59:2">Yalk. Gen. 59</cite> (some ed. <he>רקיתא</he>). [Mus. derives our w. fr. <cite ref="G00404"><he>זיקא</he></cite>, cmp. <cite ref="G00228"><he>זַוְקָאנָא</he></cite>, the chamæleon being believed to live on air.]
